title: Salt & Stone Aluminum Free Deodorant | Extra Strength 48 Hour Protection for Women & Men | Made with Seaweed Extracts, Niacinamide & Prebiotics | Santal & Vetiver

reviews.title: Great Scent and Surprisingly Long-Lasting
reviews.body: I've tried quite a few aluminum-free deodorants, and this is one of the better ones I've used. The Santal & Vetiver scent is really nice—clean, woodsy, and not overpowering. It smells more like a subtle fragrance than a typical deodorant.The formula goes on smoothly and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. I also like that it contains ingredients like niacinamide and seaweed extracts, which seem to be gentler on my skin than some other natural deodorants I've tried.As for performance, it holds up well throughout the day, even during warmer weather and light workouts. While I wouldn't personally count on a full 48 hours of protection, it definitely lasts longer than many other aluminum-free options I've used.The price is a bit higher than standard deodorants, but the quality, scent, and effectiveness make it worth considering if you're looking for a premium aluminum-free deodorant.

reviews.author: Minh Diesel

reviews.title: An Intensely Moody, Premium Blend with Uncompromised Odor Defense
reviews.body: Finding a clean, aluminum-free option that provides long-lasting freshness while leaning into a sophisticated, moody aesthetic is a rare find, but this extra-strength formula hits the mark perfectly. Built around an incredibly rich, high-end fragrance profile, it completely bypasses the cheap, overly synthetic floral scents common in the grooming aisle. Instead, it opens with a dramatic bouquet of black rose and crisp lily of the valley, settling into a deep, warm heart of oud and mahogany. The base notes of vetiver, amber, and santal ground the blend, creating a smooth, dark, and complex aroma that feels more like a luxury boutique perfume than a simple daily utility. Beyond its standout fragrance, the actual performance on the skin delivers an exceptional five-star experience. The solid stick glides on completely clear and smooth without leaving any gummy or cakey buildup, remaining completely comfortable through intensive activities and long workdays. Formulated with prebiotics to actively balance the skin’s microbiome alongside vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and antioxidant-rich spirulina, it deeply hydrates and protects the underarm area from irritation. It offers a premium, clean, and uncompromised level of care that cuts out harsh chemicals, parabens, and aluminum while keeping your clothes stain-free and your personal space smelling expertly curated.

reviews.author: Paris Bodhi

reviews.title: Blowed my expectations away.
reviews.body: I should start off by saying that I generally don't wear deodorant. I have a very clean lifestyle, and as a result I don't have much body odor. With that said, when I am training hard and during the summer time, body odor can become something to manage. Most deodorants I come across, even those that are marketed as clean and simple, will irritate my skin and result in rashes. I have tried many, many clean, simple brands, but almost all of them have had poor results.I ended up finding Salt and Stone with the help of AI search, and after comparing two or three of the cleanest brands I could find, I went with this deodorant. I am so happy I found it. This is the first deodorant in years that I've used that didn't irritate my skin at all. It also happens to last a very long time. I cannot believe it. I can put it on at 2 or 3 p.m. on one day and wake up and still smell like it's freshly applied by the same time the next day. I can also use it very sparingly and still the subtle, mature scent stays on.I am honestly so impressed by the product they have made and the scents that they have, and I look forward to reordering this in the future. If you have sensitive skin like I do, make sure you're doing your research and reading all the ingredient lists. This one seems to be one of the best options. I should note that I've also looked at many of the natural deodorant brands out there, the ones that use essential oil and claim that to be good for sensitive skin. The truth is that essential oils can also be very harsh on the skin, and many of these products, although they look good on paper, don't necessarily live up to the expectations in reality as a whole.

reviews.body: First off, I really like this deodorant, and I like this fragrance.I am a male, and I wanted something that was kind to my skin and not irritate it or leave boils, and would last an entire day.First off, I really like this, and it works for an entire day. I would give it 5 stars; though, I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: KNW

reviews.title: Doesn't last long and Burns a little
reviews.body: I have been wanting to try this brand for a while now and couldn't justify spending the money on it. Well, I finally bit the bullet and bought the hair and body mist and deodorant. I haven't received the body mist yet. Today was my first time using the deodorant.Right out the gate, the packaging is very cute. And the aroma  really grabbed my attention.The product smells amazing, it's grainy on the skin when you apply it. I read many reviews saying the smell doesn't last long. So I did my homework on figuring out how to prevent it from fading out too quickly.Sadly, nothing has worked as of yet. I have had to re-apply it 3 times today already and since it is aluminum free (not a bad thing, one of the many reasons I bought it) you sweat through it, and it smells worse than had it just been sweat alone in the first place.I really do love the scent, I just wish it would last longer. I don't think I can justify buying the deodorant again. Maybe in winter months!  I hope the hair and body mist last longer. I feel like if I used this deodorant daily, at this rate, I'd run out in a week or 2. Also, it is kinda burning my skin. That may be a personal issue, but I do not have any allergies aside from latex as far as topical products go. I've also never used anything like this before.

reviews.title: Smells like Baccarat Rouge!
reviews.body: I just purchased the saffron and cedar deodorant to try it out. I did not expect it smells like Baccarat Rouge without spending almost $400 for it. Also actually smells less sweat on me compared to Baccarat. It last all day. And even after working out, i didnt notice any body odor. I shower daily so i wouldnt know if it will last 48 hrs. I think the price is fair, for the quality it provides.
